## Documentation and evidence updates

- [ ] Governing documentation updated or no change required with reason.
- [ ] Traceability/registers updated or deferred to the approved dependent task.
- [ ] Evidence contains no secrets, production personal data, or private customer material.
- [ ] Screenshots and logs are redacted.
- [ ] No readiness or activation claim exceeds the evidence.

## Reviewer checklist

- [ ] Task scope and source authority are explicit.
- [ ] Risk class and high-risk controls are addressed.
- [ ] Dependencies are satisfied or safely simulated.
- [ ] Acceptance criteria are objectively evidenced.
- [ ] Required tests were run; skipped suites are visible.
- [ ] Progressive/deferred behaviour remains inactive.
- [ ] Rollback or forward-fix is credible.
- [ ] Product, Engineering, QA, Security/Privacy, Finance, Operations, or Logistics review is requested where applicable.
- [ ] This PR is not self-approved, self-merged, or treated as production activation.
